title: Require corroboration for blocking synthesis constraints
context: Model-synthesized severity labels with empty affected_files were auto-minting repo-wide blocking denies, silently preventing all subsequent edits under strict firmness. Touches invariant(s): con_2ce3f2a547 (Synthesis must use an explicitly selected coding-assistant subscription CLI or the deterministic local fallback; never call a pay-per-token API); con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Blocking constraints now require both a real file scope AND deterministic corroboration (recurrence), mirroring the safety guard already used in human-correction paths.
consequences: Prevents model output from silently creating repo-wide denies
Aligns constraint-generation safety policy across synthesis and human-correction paths
Requires repeated signals or explicit validation before enforcement escalates to blocking level
alternatives_rejected: Allow model-supplied severity to directly mint blocking constraints
Check only file scope without requiring deterministic corroboration
Accept inconsistent safety gates between human and model constraint paths
